# uniswap_module

> Uniswap price oracle + swap router: V2/V3/V4 token prices (best-rate, Multicall3-batched) and V2/V3 swap building. Multi-chain, configurable.

## API at a glance

| Method | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `configure` | `configure(chain_json: tstr) -> bool` | Add or override a chain's Uniswap config (JSON of `ChainUniswap`). |
| `get_chains` | `get_chains() -> tstr` | All configured chains (defaults + overrides). |
| `get_prices` | `get_prices(chain_id: int, tokens_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Token→ETH and token→USD prices for `{ "tokens": [{address, decimals}] }`, best-rate across V2/V3/V4, batched into one Multicall3 `eth_call`. |
| `quote_swap` | `quote_swap(chain_id: int, params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | Best swap quote for `{ tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, owner? }` (native = "ETH"): the route, its output, the price impact, a gas hint, and — with `owner` — the account's balance and whether an approval must go first. |
| `build_swap` | `build_swap(chain_id: int, params_json: tstr) -> tstr` | The quote plus the calls that make the swap, in order, in the shape `tx_sender_module` takes: `{ calls: [{ kind, to, value, data, gasLimitHint, label }] }`. |
